_comment: What tools/harness.py boots and what each capture must prove.
A project appears here only once it has been EXPORTED to `dist`, because the
desktop runtime under test is the exported game -- the render path a player
actually takes. Exporting the 31 Examples and 16 templates is the next piece
of this work; until then this file lists what is genuinely wired, so the
report cannot imply coverage that does not exist.
frames: which frame ordinals to photograph. Two, far apart, because one
picture cannot tell a still scene from a stopped one. The first is late
enough that boot defaults are no longer on screen.
claims.draws: the frame is not one flat colour.
claims.animates.min_changed_pct: how much of the frame must move between the
first and last capture. Raise it for a scene that should be visibly busy;
lower it for one where only a small region moves.
